article.short_description: Resolution: INC0010042 - 1. Verify network/connectivity from affected clients (ping,
article.text:
Incident: INC0010042

Full resolution steps:
- 1. Verify network/connectivity from affected clients (ping, traceroute to VPN gateway) and check gateway logs.
- 2. Restart VPN service/process or fail over to standby gateway; clear stale sessions if required.
- 3. Validate successful user connections, close monitoring alerts, and add close notes referencing root cause and fix.

Incident: INC0010042
Short description: Demo: VPN Outage - users cannot connect to corporate VPN

article.short_description: Resolution: INC0010043 - 1. Check DB host health (CPU, memory, I/O), and DB listener/
article.text:
Incident: INC0010043

Full resolution steps:
- 1. Check DB host health (CPU, memory, I/O), and DB listener/status (tnsping, listener.log).
- 2. Restart database listener/service or apply the validated DB patch; clear blocked sessions and run quick integrity checks.
- 3. Verify application connections, run smoke tests, document root cause and remediation steps in close notes.

Incident: INC0010043
Short description: Demo: Oracle Database is not available - connection timeout errors

article.text:
Incident: INC0010049

Full resolution steps:
- 1. Inspect printer server queue and spooler service; identify stuck jobs and offending documents.
- 2. Restart print spooler service and clear or reprint stuck jobs; update drivers or permissions if needed.
- 3. Confirm successful print job flow from Finance, notify affected users, and document steps taken and any follow-ups.

Incident: INC0010049
Short description: Demo: Printer queue is failing for Finance department

article.text:
Incident: INC0010050

Resolution steps:
- Restart the affected service or process
- Clear transient caches and verify connectivity
- Confirm monitoring alerts are cleared and close the incident

Incident: INC0010050
Short description: Demo: Certificate expired on web-gateway.example.com
